spans.claim: Stanley Rees disappeared mysteriously from his hotel room

spans.claim: Josephine Dredlinton is unhappy in her marriage and allies with Wingate
spans.anchor: I have so few friends

spans.anchor: I put you on because of your wife

spans.span: Lord Dredlinton's death was due to exhaustion, but the doctor certifies that he was suffering, and has been for some time, from advanced valvular disease of the heart.

spans.claim: Wingate controls the house and servants to maintain captivity
